EVENT INFO: There is a two-item minimum purchase requirement in the showroom for all guests. Seating is general admission, first-come, first-served, with the exception of groups and premium booths. Guests are allowed into our showroom up until 30 minutes after the show begins. We stop seating 30 minutes into the show due to the disruption caused to the performers. No exceptions, no refunds. No cell phone use, photography or video recording is permitted during performances. All sales are final. MISCELLANOUS: For group sales info, e-mail our Events Manager to learn about special menu options and reserved seating. Additional questions may be addressed in our Frequently Asked Questions. For further assistance, contact Denver Improv.
events.pleaseNote: This event is 21 and over. Any ticket holder unable to present valid identification indicating that they are at least 21 years of age will not be admitted to this event, and will not be eligible for a refund. Seating: All seating is first come, first served at Management's discretion. All tables, including VIP, are generally shared seating. If you would like a private 4-person table, you must purchase all 4 seats. Otherwise, you may be seated with another party. Group Requests: If you would like to be seated with another party, please make a note in the comments section at checkout, call our Box Office during business hours, or email denver.boxoffice@improv.com. While we do our best to accommodate, we cannot guarantee group seating unless your entire party arrives together. For best results, please meet in the lobby before entering the showroom. Late Arrivals & Re-entry: To ensure the best experience for all guests and performers, doors close 30 minutes after showtime. Late arrivals or guests who exit the building after entry will not be readmitted. No exceptions. All Sales Are Final: No refunds. No exchanges. No exceptions. 2-Item Minimum: There is a two-item minimum per person inside the showroom (food or drink). PLEASE NOTE: Any disruptive behavior may result in immediate ejection from the venue without warning or refund. Examples of disruptive behavior include, but are not limited to: Heckling or interrupting the show Excessive talking at your table Refusing to share your table (if all 4 seats were not purchased together) Smoking or vaping indoors Aggressive, inappropriate, or disrespectful conduct towards staff or other guests Unauthorized photography or video recording Unauthorized live streaming of any kind Photo/Video/Streaming: Permission for photos or recordings is at the sole discretion of the General Manager. Please check with management before taking any media during the show. Thank you for helping us create a respectful and enjoyable environment for all guests and performers.

venues.parkingDetail: The Colorado Convention Center provides onsite parking in a brand new 1000 space parking garage. There are 650 covered spaces available on the garage's first two levels and an additional 350 spaces are available on the top deck. Since the garage provides direct access to the campus of facilities encompassing the Colorado Convention Center and the Denver Performing Arts Complex parking in Downtown Denver has never been easier. The garage is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to ALL visitors and guests attending ANY event or business in the downtown area. Please remember to arrive early to avoid possible event traffic and lines. Monthly parking is available by calling Parking Management at 303-228-8070. Enter the parking garage via North-bound Speer Boulevard just before Champa Street. There is a second entrance into the garage from west-bound Champa Street (left-hand turn) just before Speer.

events.name: Sara Bareilles: The Good Grief Tour
KSE Venue Ball Arena Tours
events.description:
Step behind the scenes at Ball Arena and discover what it takes to operate one of the busiest sports and entertainment venues in North America. Home to the NBA's Denver Nuggets, NHL's Colorado Avalanche, NLL's Colorado Mammoth, and a wide variety of concerts and special events, Ball Arena provides guests with a unique look at the inner workings of a world-class arena.

During this approximately 90-minute guided walking tour, guests will explore exclusive areas not typically accessible to the public, including premium suites, the Michelob ULTRA Mountain House, the arena bowl, backstage hallways, production and broadcast areas, and other operational spaces throughout the venue. Depending on availability, guests may also have the opportunity to visit team locker rooms, view the Avalanche hallway, or see the Nuggets practice court (if  available). 

Throughout the experience, guests will learn about the history of Ball Arena, major sporting events and concerts hosted at the venue, and the game-day operations that bring events to life. Tour guides will share insights into event production, security, guest experience, premium hospitality, broadcasting, facility management, and the many departments that work together to create memorable experiences for fans and guests.
